text: Afwaah chhat ki\nthi... par sach\nkahin aur chhupa!
Clue isi video\nmein hai.\nDhyaan se dekhna!
Kehte hain chhat\npar ek BHOOTNI\nghoomti hai!
Kal raat KAVYA\nwahan gayi...\nwapas nahi aayi
SHARMA AUNTY\n"Main to kehti thi...\nhaveli SHAAPIT hai!"
"Kavya ko tehkhaane\nmein jaane ki kya\nzaroorat thi?"
"Main to aaj tak\nwahan gaya bhi nahi"
Shivam ki nazar se\nkoi nahi bachta.
